messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] High p99 decode latency detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Auto-routing: 10% -> fallback-quant. Pager: @sanjeev @laura. Logs attached.

sanjeev: picking this up. seeing p95 ~420ms -> p99 ~1.2s on streaming responses, multiple streaming stalls reported (>=10s). Repro on dedicated pool too.

laura: confirmed in dashboards — sudden jump at 2026-03-15T01:04Z correlated with a kernel rollout (trt8+flashattn build) at 01:00Z. A/B cohort shows jump only on nodes with new compile flags: -O3 -use_fast_math -ftree-vectorize.

anita: customer-facing impact: two paying Dedicated tenants hit increased tail latency, no errors but degraded streaming UX. CS notified for both accounts. No SLO breach yet for total revenue but p99 SLO risk.

mike: grabbing logs from worker-35 (one affected VM). tail of decode logs:

```
[01:05:12] decode_kernel: initializing flash_attn_v2
[01:05:12] nvrtc: compiling kernels with flags: -O3 -use_fast_math -ftree-vectorize
[01:05:12] warn: fp32->fp16 fallback occurred in GEMM
[01:05:13] decode: kv-cache-miss handled, cold-path triggered
[01:05:22] stream: stall detected: last token delivered at +9.8s
p95=0.42s p99=1.23s
```

kevin: interesting — FP math flags might be changing numerical behavior and kernel tiling causing cache thrash. There's also a new kernel switch in the compile path that prefers flash_attn_v2 for short sequences; could be mis-triggering on some token lengths.

sanjeev: immediate plan: 1) roll back the compile flags on a small pool and compare; 2) add temporary routing policy to divert 50% of live traffic from latest kernel pool to previous stable pool; 3) enable FORCE_LEGACY_DECODE=1 on affected hosts as hotpatch.

ops-bot: routing-change executed: 50% traffic shifted from pool trt8-flashattn-2026-03-15 -> trt8-stable-2026-03-08.

pagerduty-bot: @sanjeev acknowledged the page. Estimated MTTR: 45m.

laura: applying FORCE_LEGACY_DECODE via ssm command to two most impacted hosts now. command:

```
sudo systemctl set-environment FORCE_LEGACY_DECODE=1 && sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference-worker
```

anita: CS updated: we told customers we're investigating and have partial mitigation, offered to move high-priority jobs to standby region.

mike: after forcing legacy decode on host-35, p99 dropped to 0.35s for that host. Streaming stalls gone. Looks strongly tied to the new kernel/flags.

kevin: rolling back the compile flag set across the rollout group. Triggering new build with flags: -O2 (no -use_fast_math), and marking it candidate. CI: compile/quicktest underway.

sanjeev: creating quick canary: redeploy candidate to 3 nodes, run synthetic streaming workload. If p99 < 500ms and no stalls -> promote.

ops-bot: deploy started: candidate-image: trt8-flashattn-r2 (flags: -O2).

mike: canary results after 10m: p95 0.38s, p99 0.46s, no stalls. Candidate looks good.

anita: CS: told affected customers mitigation in place and ETA for full rollback ~30-45m. No impact to billing.

sanjeev: promoting candidate to remaining nodes in the group with staged rollout (10% -> 30% -> 100%). Will monitor 5m between steps.

laura: note for postmortem: failure mode appears to be kernel tiling + aggressive fast-math optimizations combined with flashattn v2 microkernel; triggers on short seqs with certain batch distributions, causing cache miss storms and long tail in decode. Need deterministic unit tests for short-seq tiling.

kevin: filed a follow-up GH issue linking compile flags, kernel version, and perf regression. Assigning to eng-runtime: @kevin, @mike.

mike: open tasks before handoff to next oncall:
- confirm all nodes rolled back and healthy (monitoring: p99 < 600ms)
- collect affected host kernel build artifacts and nvrtc log dump
- add unit test for short-seq flashattn path
- coordinate with model-onboarding to mark trt8-flashattn-r1 as quarantined until patch

sanjeev: current status: rollouts at 100% for rollback image, p99 trending back to baseline (p99 ~0.48s cluster-wide). No new streaming stalls in last 12m.

sanjeev: handing off to @kevin for overnight watch and postmortem writeup. Handoff checklist: brief summary, customer list, artifacts links, GH issue #1127.

kevin: taking over. I'll keep an eye on us-west-2 for 2 hours and start the postmortem doc. Thanks all.

ops-bot: incident status changed to mitigated by @kevin. Monitoring for 2h.

pagerduty-bot: oncall handoff recorded: from sanjeev -> kevin at 2026-03-15T01:27Z.

laura: note that TRT vendor announced minor microkernel change yesterday — we should update upgrade checklist to include synthetic short-seq streaming tests before rollout.

anita: I'll draft customer-facing post-incident notes and shared changelog.

kevin: copying final commands used for hotpatch/rollback into the ticket for reproducibility:

```
# hotpatch legacy decode
for host in host-31 host-35; do
  ssh $host \"sudo systemctl set-environment FORCE_LEGACY_DECODE=1 && sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference-worker\"
done

# rollback build tag
kubectl set image deployment/inference-pool trt8=registry/redwood/trt8-flashattn-r2:20260315 --namespace=prod-us-west-2
```

laura: good run. we'll reconvene in the postmortem to assign long-term fixes (unit tests, compile gating, canary improvements).

kevin: closing thread for now — will append postmortem link here when ready.

ops-bot: thread archived by @kevin.
